Who you'll meet

Many of us are expats, working professionals, families and retirees.

Your first Sunday is simple.

Come at 9:30 for coffee, or 10:00 for the service. Either is fine.

Enter through the main lobby and take the elevator to Floor 2.

The service runs about 90 minutes. Kids age 4 through 5th grade have their own program.
